18
Nna mu akyiwadeɛ
1Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 2Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn. 3#Eks 23.24 Misraim asase a motenaa soɔ no so nneyɛɛ deɛ, monnyɛ. Na Kanaan asase a mede mo rekɔ soɔ no so nneyɛɛ nso, monnyɛ, na monnni wɔn ahyɛdeɛ so. 4M’atemmudeɛ na monyɛ, na monkora m’ahyɛdeɛ sɛ mobɛdi soɔ. 5#Neh 9.29; Hes 20.11; Rom 10.5; Gal 3.12 Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn. Na monkora m’ahyɛdeɛ ne m’atemmudeɛ a onipa a ɔyɛ no bɛnya mu nkwa no. Mene AWURADE.
6Obiara nnkɔ ne bogya biara a ɔyɛ ne honam no ho nnkɔyi n’adagya so. Mene AWURADE. 7Nyi w’agya anaa wo na adagya so; wo na ne no, nyi n’adagya so. 8#Gye 35.22; Deut 27.20; 1 Ko 5.1 Nyi w’agya yere adagya so; w’agya adagya ne no. 9#Deut 27.22 Wo nuabaa a ɔyɛ w’agya ba anaa wo na ba no, wɔwoo no efie oo, wɔwoo no baabi oo, nyi wɔn adagya so. 10Wo babanin babaa anaa wo babaa babaa, nyi wɔn adagya so, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ w’adagya. 11W’agya yere babaa a w’agya awo no no, ɔyɛ wo nuabaa, nyi n’adagya so. 12Nyi w’agya nuabaa adagya so; ɔyɛ w’agya honam. 13Nyi wo na nuabaa adagya so, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ wo na honam. 14Nyi w’agya nuabarima adagya so nkɔ ne yere ho; wo na kumaa ne no. 15#Gye 38.16 Nyi w’ase adagya so; wo babarima yere ne no, nyi n’adagya so. 16#Mar 6.18 Nyi wo nua yere adagya so; ɛyɛ wo nua adagya. 17#Deut 27.23 Nyi ɔbaa bi ne ne ba adagya so; mfa ne babanin babaa anaa ne babaa babaa nyi wɔn adagya so; ne honam ne wɔn; ɛyɛ abusudeɛ. 18Na mfa ɔbaa ne ne nua nware sɛ wobɛma wɔatwe kora, sɛ ɔda so te aseɛ no, wobɛyi n’adagya so aka ne ho.
19 # Lew 15.24; Hes 18.6; 22.10 Na nkɔ ɔbaa a ne nsabuo mu ne ho nteeɛ no ho nkɔyi n’adagya so. 20#2 Sa 11.4 Na wo ne wo yɔnko yere nnna, na mfa wo ho nsuo mma no mfa ngu wo ne no ho fi. 21#Deut 18.10; 2 Ah 21.6; Dwom 106.37; Yer 7.31 Na mfa w’asefoɔ mu bi mmɔ afɔdeɛ#18.21 Hebri mma wɔmmfa ogya mu. mmma Molek, na ngu wo Nyankopɔn din ho fi; mene AWURADE. 22#Gye 19.5; Rom 1.27; 1 Ko 6.9 Na wo ne ɔbarima nnna ɔbaa nna; ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ. 23#Eks 22.19 Wo ne aboa biara nnna mmfa nngu wo ho fi; na ɔbaa bi nnnyina aboa bi anim nnnane ne ho mmma no; ɛyɛ basabasayɛ.
24Mommfa nnoɔma yi biara nngu mo ho fi, ɛfiri sɛ yeinom nyinaa na amanaman a merebɛtu wɔn afiri mo anim yi de agu wɔn ho fi, 25na asase no so agu fi, enti na meretua ɛso amumuyɛ no so ka, na asase no afe ɛsotefoɔ no agu. 26Na mo deɛ, monni m’ahyɛdeɛ ne m’atemmudeɛ so, na monnyɛ saa akyiwadeɛ yi mu biara, kuromani oo, ɔhɔhoɔ a wabɛsoɛ mo mu oo, 27ɛfiri sɛ saa akyiwadeɛ yi nyinaa na asase no sofoɔ a wɔdi mo anim no ayɛ, na asase no so agu fi. 28Na asase no amfe mo angu sɛ moagu ho fi, sɛdeɛ ɛfee amanaman a wɔdii mo anim no guiɛ no. 29Na obiara a ɔbɛyɛ saa akyiwadeɛ yi mu biara no, wɔbɛtwa wɔn a wɔyɛ no afiri wɔn man mu atwene. 30Enti monhwɛ m’ahwɛdeɛ, na moanyɛ ahyɛdeɛ a wɔkyire a wɔdii mo anim yɛeɛ no amfa angu mo ho fi: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn. Misraim asase a motenaa soɔ no so nneyɛɛ deɛ, monnyɛ. Na Kanaan asase a mede mo rekɔ soɔ no so nneyɛɛ nso, monnyɛ, na monnni wɔn ahyɛdeɛ so. M’atemmudeɛ na monyɛ, na monkora m’ahyɛdeɛ sɛ mobɛdi soɔ. Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn. Na monkora m’ahyɛdeɛ ne m’atemmudeɛ a onipa a ɔyɛ no bɛnya mu nkwa no. Mene AWURADE.
Obiara nnkɔ ne bogya biara a ɔyɛ ne honam no ho nnkɔyi n’adagya so. Mene AWURADE. Nyi w’agya anaa wo na adagya so; wo na ne no, nyi n’adagya so. Nyi w’agya yere adagya so; w’agya adagya ne no. Wo nuabaa a ɔyɛ w’agya ba anaa wo na ba no, wɔwoo no efie oo, wɔwoo no baabi oo, nyi wɔn adagya so. Wo babanin babaa anaa wo babaa babaa, nyi wɔn adagya so, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ w’adagya. W’agya yere babaa a w’agya awo no no, ɔyɛ wo nuabaa, nyi n’adagya so. Nyi w’agya nuabaa adagya so; ɔyɛ w’agya honam. Nyi wo na nuabaa adagya so, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ wo na honam. Nyi w’agya nuabarima adagya so nkɔ ne yere ho; wo na kumaa ne no. Nyi w’ase adagya so; wo babarima yere ne no, nyi n’adagya so. Nyi wo nua yere adagya so; ɛyɛ wo nua adagya. Nyi ɔbaa bi ne ne ba adagya so; mfa ne babanin babaa anaa ne babaa babaa nyi wɔn adagya so; ne honam ne wɔn; ɛyɛ abusudeɛ. Na mfa ɔbaa ne ne nua nware sɛ wobɛma wɔatwe kora, sɛ ɔda so te aseɛ no, wobɛyi n’adagya so aka ne ho.
Na nkɔ ɔbaa a ne nsabuo mu ne ho nteeɛ no ho nkɔyi n’adagya so. Na wo ne wo yɔnko yere nnna, na mfa wo ho nsuo mma no mfa ngu wo ne no ho fi. Na mfa w’asefoɔ mu bi mmɔ afɔdeɛ mmma Molek, na ngu wo Nyankopɔn din ho fi; mene AWURADE. Na wo ne ɔbarima nnna ɔbaa nna; ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ. Wo ne aboa biara nnna mmfa nngu wo ho fi; na ɔbaa bi nnnyina aboa bi anim nnnane ne ho mmma no; ɛyɛ basabasayɛ.
Mommfa nnoɔma yi biara nngu mo ho fi, ɛfiri sɛ yeinom nyinaa na amanaman a merebɛtu wɔn afiri mo anim yi de agu wɔn ho fi, na asase no so agu fi, enti na meretua ɛso amumuyɛ no so ka, na asase no afe ɛsotefoɔ no agu. Na mo deɛ, monni m’ahyɛdeɛ ne m’atemmudeɛ so, na monnyɛ saa akyiwadeɛ yi mu biara, kuromani oo, ɔhɔhoɔ a wabɛsoɛ mo mu oo, ɛfiri sɛ saa akyiwadeɛ yi nyinaa na asase no sofoɔ a wɔdi mo anim no ayɛ, na asase no so agu fi. Na asase no amfe mo angu sɛ moagu ho fi, sɛdeɛ ɛfee amanaman a wɔdii mo anim no guiɛ no. Na obiara a ɔbɛyɛ saa akyiwadeɛ yi mu biara no, wɔbɛtwa wɔn a wɔyɛ no afiri wɔn man mu atwene. Enti monhwɛ m’ahwɛdeɛ, na moanyɛ ahyɛdeɛ a wɔkyire a wɔdii mo anim yɛeɛ no amfa angu mo ho fi: Mene AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
